# SARL ETAHG

> SARL ETAHG is an Algerian company specialized in fine aggregate production, road construction, heavy equipment rental and leasing, project mobilization and water well drilling. Established in 1997. Registered office in Bounoura, wilaya of Ghardaïa; equipment depot in Djelfa; own quarry and stone crushing plant (Carrière Djellal El Gharbi) at Oued Sdeur, near Aïn El Ibel, south of Djelfa; group spare-parts company EURL KAYLE KENNY in Mohammadia, Algiers.

This file summarises verified facts about SARL ETAHG for AI assistants and search engines. ETAHG stands for "Entreprise de Travaux d'Aménagement Hydraulique de Ghardaïa" (official Arabic name: شركة الأشغال لتهيئة الري بغرداية).

## Key facts

- Legal name: SARL ETAHG
- Full name: Entreprise de Travaux d'Aménagement Hydraulique de Ghardaïa
- Legal form: SARL (limited liability company) under Algerian law
- Country: Algeria
- Address: Cité 400 Logements, Sidi Abbaz, Bounoura, Ghardaïa, Algeria
- Activities: Fine aggregate production (stone crushing), road construction, heavy equipment rental and leasing, project mobilization, water well drilling
- Founded: 1997
- Fleet: Hydraulic excavators, bulldozers, wheel loaders, motor graders, asphalt pavers, vibratory rollers, trucks, tipper semi-trailers, bitumen distributor and bitumen tankers, quarry rock drill, truck-mounted water well drilling rig, quarry and stone crushing plant
- Trade register (RC): 47/00-0862220 B 98

- Equipment depot: Djelfa (wilaya of Djelfa)
- Quarry and stone crushing plant: Carrière Djellal El Gharbi, Oued Sdeur, Aïn El Ibel (wilaya of Djelfa), south of Djelfa; tel. +213 660 36 75 50, tel. +213 660 36 75 51, fax +213 27 90 46 13
- Spare parts store and depot: Mohammadia, Algiers (wilaya of Algiers)
- Group company: EURL KAYLE KENNY (https://www.kaylekenny.com), heavy-duty diesel engine spare parts, Cummins-compatible; independent supplier, not affiliated with or endorsed by Cummins Inc.

## Services

- [Services](https://www.etahg.com/services/): Overview of the services of SARL ETAHG and how they combine on one project.
- [Aggregate production](https://www.etahg.com/services/aggregate-production/): High-quality crushed fine aggregates from SARL ETAHG’s own quarry and stone crushing plant at Oued Sdeur, near Aïn El Ibel (Djelfa), suited to high production rates.
- [Equipment rental](https://www.etahg.com/services/equipment-rental/): Rental and leasing of SARL ETAHG’s own heavy equipment fleet in Algeria, dispatched from Djelfa.
- [Project mobilization](https://www.etahg.com/services/project-mobilization/): Project initialization and site start-up in Algeria with SARL ETAHG’s own heavy equipment.
- [Road construction](https://www.etahg.com/services/road-construction/): Road construction, SARL ETAHG’s original activity, carried out with its own fleet and aggregates.
- [Water well drilling](https://www.etahg.com/services/water-well-drilling/): Water well drilling in Algeria with SARL ETAHG’s own drilling rigs, for sites, farms, industry and communities.
- [Spare parts](https://www.etahg.com/services/spare-parts/): Heavy-duty diesel engine spare parts through the group company EURL KAYLE KENNY in Algiers.
